editorial:
Picture this: you and your spouse finally take that dream trip to Europe, only to end up as the prime suspects in a billionaire's murder on a luxury yacht. That's the wild ride you're in for with this fun comedy mystery. Adam Sandler plays a New York cop who can't seem to get promoted, while Jennifer Aniston is his hairdresser wife who just wants a little romance. Their chemistry feels natural and easy, like a real couple bickering their way through chaos. The movie doesn't take itself too seriously, which is exactly its charm. You'll laugh at the silly situations while trying to guess who actually did it.

The pacing keeps things moving with chase scenes, gorgeous European backdrops, and a steady stream of jokes. Some gags land better than others, and the mystery itself is fairly light, but that's part of the fun. If you want a brainy thriller, this isn't it. But if you want a breezy date-night movie with two likable stars, you're in the right place.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn that the billionaire's son and his lover orchestrated the murders to inherit the fortune. The cop and his wife, who spent the whole movie running from the police, finally clear their names by exposing the real killers during a dramatic confrontation. The couple walks away free, their marriage stronger, and you get a satisfying wrap-up that ties up every loose end with a smile.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted comedy mysteries and star-driven date-night movies.
